methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were fetched directly where they render in HTML: riverside.com/pricing, descript.com/pricing, cleanfeed.net/pricing. zencastr.com/pricing and async.com/pricing are JavaScript-rendered and do not expose price numbers in static HTML; plan structures were extracted from the rendered HTML (names/limits) and prices corroborated across multiple independent third-party sources (web search, aichief.com, talks.co, keevee.com). Zencastr's four paid tiers (Standard $20, Grow $30, Scale $50, Business $100/mo) were confirmed by converging search results. Async (formerly Podcastle, rebranded 2026-01-28; podcastle.ai redirects to async.com) current monthly prices were corrected to Storyteller/Essentials $11.99 and Pro $23.99 per converging sources (aichief.com, G2, web search); the draft's $14.99/$24.99 reflected stale corroboration and were inflated. SquadCast (squadcast.fm) was acquired by Descript in 2023; squadcast.fm/pricing now shows Descript plans and routes subscriptions to descript.com, so it has no independent pricing — retained as an informational entry mirroring Descript, not a separate priced product. Monthly prices shown are month-to-month; annual-equivalent per-month figures are noted in plan notes. accessedAt 2026-06-18.

vendors.name: Riverside
vendors.provenance: Fetched riverside.com/pricing on 2026-06-18; Free $0, Pro $24/mo (was $29), Live $34/mo (was $39), Webinar $79/mo (was $99), Business custom — all confirmed on page. Annual-equivalent: Pro $24/mo ($288/yr), Live $34/mo ($408/yr), Webinar $79/mo ($948/yr at stated 20% off). 14-day free trial on paid plans. SOC2 Type II & ISO27001 noted under Business plan.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 2 hours of multi-track recording (one-time), unlimited single-track recording, up to 720p video, 44.1 kHz audio, Riverside watermark on exports, full editing suite access, Magic Clips, unlimited video calls.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: 15 hours multi-track + unlimited single-track recording; up to 4K video, 48 kHz audio; no watermark; AI editing agent, Magic Audio, unlimited transcriptions, Magic Clips, podcast analytics, YouTube & podcast directory publishing. Page shows $24/mo (regular $29). $24/mo billed annually ($288/yr).

plans.name: Live
plans.notes: Everything in Pro plus 1080p live streaming and multistreaming to unlimited destinations (YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Twitch); custom RTMP, Omnichat, live call-ins, custom overlays, lower thirds, backstage management. Page shows $34/mo (regular $39). $34/mo billed annually ($408/yr).

plans.name: Webinar
plans.notes: Everything in Live plus webinars with up to 100 registrants; pre-record & stream as live; unlimited sessions; lead capture; custom registration forms; automated email reminders; webinar analytics; HubSpot integration. Page shows $79/mo (regular $99). ~$79/mo billed annually ($948/yr).

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Custom pricing (contact sales). Up to 10,000 webinar registrants, unlimited multi-track recording, custom branding, collaborative editing, Salesforce integration, API access, SSO (Okta/Azure), SOC2 Type II & ISO27001, 24/7 priority support, dedicated Customer Success Manager.

keyFeatures: Local multi-track recording at up to 4K video / 48 kHz audio
AI editing agent and Magic Audio noise correction
Live multi-streaming to 6+ platforms simultaneously
Magic Clips AI short-form clip generator
enrichment.provenance: All plan prices read directly from riverside.com/pricing on 2026-06-18; 14-day trial and SOC2/ISO27001 confirmed on page.

vendors.name: Zencastr
vendors.provenance: zencastr.com/pricing is JavaScript-rendered (price table not in static HTML). Four paid tiers — Standard $20, Grow $30, Scale $50, Business $100/mo plus free Hobbyist — confirmed by converging web-search results and review aggregators (talks.co, keevee.com, softwarefinder.com). 20% annual discount and 14-day trial of paid features corroborated.

plans.name: Hobbyist
plans.notes: Free forever. Recording (session limit applies), 1080p video, recording masters stored ~31 days, no postproduction credits, up to 2 guests; 14-day trial of paid features available.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Unlimited recording and uploads; 1080p video; 16-bit 48k WAV audio; ZenAI editing suite; manual clipping; podcast hosting and distribution. ~$18/mo billed annually.

plans.name: Grow
plans.notes: Everything in Standard plus 4K video; AI filler word removal; AI clipping with captions; social publishing; direct YouTube publishing; postproduction credits (short-form clips). ~$24/mo billed annually.

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: Everything in Grow plus 2 shows, 2 users/seats, dynamic ad insertion, social-feed clips and social scheduling.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Up to 5 shows, 4 seats, unlimited editing/postproduction, advanced monetization features, priority support.

limits: Hobbyist: recording masters stored ~31 days only
Hobbyist: up to 2 guests per session
Postproduction credits gated to Grow+ (short-form clips), Scale+ (social-feed clips)
keyFeatures: Lossless separate-track audio/video recording in browser
ZenAI suite: filler word removal, AI clipping with captions
Built-in podcast hosting and distribution to major directories
Dynamic ad insertion on Scale+ plans
enrichment.provenance: Pricing page JS-rendered; Standard/Grow/Scale/Business at $20/$30/$50/$100 monthly with 20% annual discount and 14-day trial corroborated across multiple 2026 sources.

vendors.name: Descript
vendors.provenance: Fetched descript.com/pricing on 2026-06-18: Free $0, Hobbyist $24/mo ($16 annual), Creator $35/mo ($24 annual), Business $65/mo ($50 annual), Enterprise custom — all confirmed on page. Prices are per seat/person on paid tiers. SOC 2 Type II confirmed on page. Descript acquired SquadCast (2023); remote recording is integrated.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 60 media minutes/month; 100 AI credits (one-time); transcription in 25 languages; text-based editing; 720p export with watermark; 1 seat; integrated remote recording (~1 hour/month).

plans.name: Hobbyist
plans.notes: Per person. 10 media hours/month; 400 AI credits/month; 1080p watermark-free export; unlimited projects; dynamic captions; limited AI tools; 1 seat. $16/mo billed annually.

plans.name: Creator
plans.notes: Per person. 30 media hours/month (+5 bonus); 800 AI credits/month (+500 bonus); 4K watermark-free export; full Underlord AI suite (20+ tools); AI video generation; unlimited stock media; up to 3 seats (billed separately). $24/mo billed annually.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Per person. 40 media hours/month (+10 bonus); 1,500 AI credits/month (+1,000 bonus); Brand Studio team access; video translation/dubbing in 30+ languages; custom avatar generation; up to 5 seats (billed separately); priority support with SLA. $50/mo billed annually.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing (contact sales). Advanced SSO/SCIM, granular brand controls, custom AI credits and media minutes, custom legal terms, flexible licensing.

limits: Paid tiers: media hours quota (10–40 hrs/month)
AI credits quota per month (400–1,500 on paid tiers)
Seats billed separately on Creator and Business
keyFeatures: Text-based editing — edit audio/video by editing the transcript
Underlord AI suite: filler word removal, overdub voice cloning, eye contact correction
Integrated remote recording (via acquired SquadCast) up to 4K
Video dubbing and translation in 30+ languages (Business+)
enrichment.provenance: Fetched descript.com/pricing directly on 2026-06-18; all four published prices and SOC 2 Type II confirmed on page.

Remote multi-track recording (iso tracks, video + screen)

vendors.name: Async (formerly Podcastle)
vendors.provenance: podcastle.ai redirects to async.com (Podcastle rebranded as Async on 2026-01-28). async.com/pricing renders plan names/limits in HTML (Basic, Storyteller/Essentials, Pro, Teams, Business) but withholds price numbers (JS-required). Monthly prices CORRECTED from the draft's stale $14.99/$24.99 to $11.99 (Essentials/Storyteller) and $23.99 (Pro), corroborated by aichief.com, G2, and web search. Official messaging is 'Save up to 40% with yearly plans' (draft's 20% was wrong). Teams/Enterprise has no reliably published price (informal ~$39.99–$49.99) → monthlyUsd set null. 7-day free trial on paid plans; free Basic tier is permanent.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Free forever. ~3 hours video recording/month; ~10 hours transcription/month; limited text-to-speech; 2 GB storage; 1 creator seat; watermarked 720p video exports.

plans.name: Essentials (Storyteller)
plans.notes: 8 hours video recording/month; 10 hours transcription/month; unlimited audio recording; 20 GB storage; 450 AI credits/month; lossless WAV, 4K video, watermark removed. ~$7.19/mo billed annually (up to 40% off). 7-day free trial. Draft's $14.99/mo was inflated/stale; corrected to $11.99.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: 20 hours video recording/month; 25 hours transcription/month; unlimited audio; 120 GB storage; 1,200 AI credits/month; voice cloning (Revoice); remote recording with guests; full AI editing suite. ~$14.39/mo billed annually (up to 40% off). 7-day free trial. Draft's $24.99/mo was inflated/stale; corrected to $23.99.

plans.name: Teams
plans.notes: 50 hours remote recording/month; 1 TB storage; 3,000 AI credits/month; unlimited recording studios; multi-host access; collaboration. No reliably published price (informal estimates ~$39.99–$49.99/mo, unverified) → set to null. Contact sales.

limits: Basic: ~3 hours video recording/month, 2 GB storage
Essentials: 8 hours video recording/month, 20 GB storage
Pro: 20 hours video recording/month, 120 GB storage
keyFeatures: AI text-to-speech with voice cloning (Revoice)
AI Magic Dust audio enhancement and noise removal
Multi-track remote recording with guests (Pro+)
All-in-one record, edit, transcribe, publish to Spotify/Apple Podcasts

Plan names/limits from rendered HTML; monthly prices corrected to $11.99 / $23.99 per converging 2026 sources; Teams price null (no published figure). vendors.name: Cleanfeed
vendors.provenance: Fetched cleanfeed.net/pricing on 2026-06-18. Lite free (incl. commercial use); two Pro price points confirmed — $12/mo standard (personal/educational/nonprofit) and $36/mo business (commercial/broadcast) for the same feature set; 20% annual discount. Cinema is annual-only at $2,500/year for the first seat (not a monthly plan), so monthlyUsd is null.

plans.name: Lite
plans.notes: Free including commercial use. Clean remote audio, unlimited recording time, up to 2 remote guests, 1 local audio source, mono remote audio.

plans.name: Pro (Standard)
plans.notes: For personal, educational, or nonprofit use. All Lite features plus multitrack recording, privacy controls, markers/notes, studio tools, audio repair, volume controls, high-performance modes, buffer control, auxiliary outputs, stereo remote audio, up to 32 remote guests, 4 local audio sources, multiple accounts, email support. ~$9.60/mo billed annually (20% off).

plans.name: Pro (Business)
plans.notes: For commercial/broadcast organizations. Identical features to Pro Standard. ~$28.80/mo billed annually (20% off). The standard $12 rate applies to personal/educational/nonprofit use.

plans.name: Cinema
plans.notes: $2,500/year for the first seat (purchase or rental) — annual billing only, so no monthly price. All Pro features plus center-stage video (DCI 2K, 60fps), gallery tools, dedicated server capacity, up to 16 video guests. Rental fees accumulate toward permanent seat purchase.

limits: Lite: max 2 remote guests, 1 local audio source, mono audio only
Pro: max 32 remote guests, 4 local audio sources
Cinema: max 16 video guests; annual billing only ($2,500/yr)
keyFeatures: Browser-based low-latency remote audio recording optimized for broadcast quality
Multitrack recording with up to 32 remote guests (Pro)
Audio repair and studio tools built in
DCI 2K 60fps video for broadcast-grade remote production (Cinema)
enrichment.provenance: Fetched cleanfeed.net/pricing directly on 2026-06-18; two Pro price points ($12 standard / $36 business, 20% annual discount) and Cinema $2,500/yr confirmed on page.
